title: Adult performer application
description: JSON body posted by adult-performer-application.html. No database table or API route is provisioned yet. The page posts this object to the SUBMIT_ENDPOINT constant in that file.

instagram.description: Optional handle. The field label is Instagram or TikTok (optional). Spanish label: Instagram o TikTok (opcional). Stored in instagram.

email.description: Optional. Empty or a valid email.

acts_performed.description: English stored values. Spanish labels are Solo, Juguete, Chica con chica, Chico con chica, Anal, 2 chicas y un chico, Fetiche/BDSM, and Otro.

explicit_paid_platform.description: English stored values. Spanish labels are Sí, No, and Primero la audición.

availability_types.description: English stored values. Spanish labels are Toda la noche, Todo el día, and Después del trabajo.

pay_tier.description: Tier 1 is the Nude Modeling Program: about COP 300.000, about 3 to 4 hours, nude modeling only. No USD amount is shown on the Tier 1 card. Tier 2 is COP 1.500.000 (about US$500): full opportunity, 2 days, 16 hours in four 4-hour sessions. Empty when tier_choice is Open to discussion.

audition_ack.description: True when Tier 2 or Both is chosen and the applicant confirms the paid 1-hour audition (COP 200.000). False otherwise. The card is hidden until Tier 2 or Both is selected.

tier_choice.description: English stored value from the tier dropdown. Spanish shows Nivel 1, Nivel 2, Ambos, and Abierto a conversar.

willing_travel_resort.description: Yes or No. Spanish label: ¿Dispuesta/o a viajar a un resort?

explicit_sample_urls.description: Optional. The field label is Lingerie images or personal content (optional). Spanish: Imágenes en lencería o contenido personal (opcional). Empty when none are uploaded.

consents.description: tier2-unprotected-sti is required when pay_tier is Tier 2 or Both. It is omitted for Tier 1.
